interpretations: Return one row containing the unrounded, unweighted average of the per-`MediaTypeId` averages of `Bytes / Milliseconds` and the unrounded, unweighted average of the per-`MediaTypeId` track counts, using only tracks with `Bytes > 10,323,804` and media types represented by those tracks.
queries:
SELECT
    AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond),
    AVG(track_count)
FROM (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
